implementation_basis.requirements: ProjectService.extract_requirements -> _run_requirement_extraction; one initial provider operation plus one bounded schema-repair operation (recursive retry).
implementation_basis.plan: _create_compact_plan_from_specification uses range(2); one initial Plan operation plus one bounded Plan repair operation.
implementation_basis.geometry: generate_initial_revision starts one source operation; geometry-slot completion or legacy fallback may add one focused operation; one mutually exclusive source-contract, geometry-body, or runtime repair may add one more.
implementation_basis.transport: run-live-api.sh sets VOLUNDR_GEMINI_API_MAX_RETRIES=1; eligible timeout/5xx retry remains on the original credential.
implementation_basis.rate_limit: One primary-to-fallback credential switch is permitted only after HTTP 429, with the preregistered wait; no credential rotation for semantic, contract, worker, topology, or verification failures.
